title: Rescaling a vanishing normalized quotient: F(ρ)/ρᵏ → 0 implies r⁻ᵏ·F(Rr) → 0 for every R > 0
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ and let F : ℝ → [0, ∞] be any function (no measurability or continuity is assumed) such that F(ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal(ρᵏ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+ (along 𝓝[>] 0). Then for every real R > 0, ENNReal.ofReal((rᵏ)⁻¹) · F(R·r) → 0 in [0, ∞] as r → 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => F ρ / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * F (R * r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
